items.title: 8.9 Relationships between various equilibrium constants (equilibrium constants ka aapas mein rishta) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.9, printed pages 176-179, with Quick Check 8.5 as self-checks.

blocks.text: Reversible reaction ka equilibrium constant chaar types ki quantities (miqdarein) se nikala ja sakta hai. General (aam) reaction yeh lein:
(1) Jab reactants aur products ki concentrations mol dm⁻³ mein hon to equilibrium constant yun likha jata hai:
Square brackets [ ] mol dm⁻³ ke liye istemal hote hain.
(2) Jab gases ki amount partial pressures (p, total pressure mein har gas ka apna hissa) mein ho to:
(3) Jab amount number of moles (n) mein ho to:
(4) Jab amount mole fractions (X, total moles mein har cheez ka hissa) mein ho to:
In constants ka aapas mein relation (rishta) yeh hai:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne equation (7) Kp = Kn (N)^Δn chhapi hai. Har gas ka partial pressure p = (n / N) × P hota hai, is liye sahi relation Kp = Kn (P/N)^Δn hai, jahan P system ka total pressure aur N total moles hain. Δn = 0 ho to (P/N)⁰ = 1 aur Kp = Kn.

items: T = system ka absolute temperature (Kelvin mein)
N = reactants aur products ke total moles
Δn = balanced equation mein products ke moles minus reactants ke moles

blocks.text: Kaun sa constant bara hai aur kaun chhota, yeh Δn ki value par depend karta hai. Agar balanced equation mein reactants aur products ke moles barabar hon to sab constants ki value barabar hoti hai:

blocks.text_alt: Δn = 0 then Kp = Kc = Kx = Kn

blocks.text: Yani us case mein concentration ki koi bhi unit istemal karein, equilibrium constant ek hi rehta hai.

blocks.title: Sample Problem 8.3
blocks.problem: N₂(g) aur H₂(g) mil kar NH₃(g) banate hain. 500 °C par Kc = 6.0 × 10⁻² hai. Is reaction ka Kp nikalein.
steps: Step 1: Given (diya gaya data) likhein. Required: Kp = ? N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) ⇌ 2NH₃(g); Kc = 6.0 × 10⁻²; T = 500 + 273 = 773 K; R = 0.0821 dm³ atm K⁻¹ mol⁻¹.
Step 3: Δn = products ke moles − reactants ke moles = 2 − (1 + 3) = −2.
blocks.answer: Kp = 1.5 × 10⁻⁵; Kp, Kc se chhota hai kyun ke Δn negative (manfi) hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne jawab 1.4 × 10⁻⁵ likha hai. 0.06 / 4032.25 = 1.49 × 10⁻⁵ banta hai, jo do significant figures tak 1.5 × 10⁻⁵ hai. Result (Kp < Kc) wahi rehta hai.

blocks.title: Sample Problem 8.4
blocks.problem: 2SO₂(g) + O₂(g) ⇌ 2SO₃(g) mein equilibrium partial pressures: SO₂ = 1.0 × 10⁶ Pa, O₂ = 7.0 × 10⁶ Pa, SO₃ = 8.0 × 10⁶ Pa. Kp nikalein.
steps:
Given: pSO₂ = 1.0 × 10⁶ Pa, pO₂ = 7.0 × 10⁶ Pa, pSO₃ = 8.0 × 10⁶ Pa. Required: Kp = ?
Step 1: Kp partial pressures se: Kp = (pSO₃)² / (pSO₂)² × pO₂.

blocks.prompt: a) Ammonia synthesis aur PCl₅ ke dissociation (tootne) mein Kc aur Kp ka muqabla karein.
blocks.explanation: Ammonia synthesis (N₂ + 3H₂ ⇌ 2NH₃): Δn = −2, is liye Kp = Kc (RT)⁻², yani Kp, Kc se chhota. PCl₅ ⇌ PCl₃ + Cl₂: Δn = +1, is liye Kp = Kc × RT, yani Kp, Kc se bara.

blocks.prompt: b) Mixture ka total pressure 2.0 × 10⁷ Pa, nitrogen ka partial pressure 1.5 × 10⁷ Pa aur hydrogen ka 0.4 × 10⁷ Pa hai. Kp nikalein.

items: Kc (concentrations), Kp (partial pressures), Kn (moles), Kx (mole fractions).
Kp = Kc (RT)^Δn = Kx (P)^Δn = Kn (P/N)^Δn; Δn = 0 ho to sab barabar.
773 K par ammonia: Kc = 6.0 × 10⁻², Δn = −2, Kp = 1.5 × 10⁻⁵. SO₃ banna: Kp = 9.1 × 10⁻⁶ Pa⁻¹.
